posts.text:
🤝 Strategic Partnership Announcement

We’re excited to partner with @XAgent_official to explore new opportunities across the AI Agent and RWA economies.

Freedom Asset is building a permissionless, multi-chain marketplace for real-world assets, while X-Agent enables anyone to build, deploy, and operate autonomous AI agents through natural language.

Together, we’ll explore how AI agents can interact with, discover, and unlock new utility for on-chain real-world assets — bringing intelligent automation and open financial infrastructure closer together.

More collaborations and ecosystem initiatives coming soon. 🚀
